newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Prominent lawyer gunned down in Bogota.
newsitem.headline: Prominent lawyer gunned down in Bogota.

text.p: A lawyer who was involved in one of Colombia's most closely watched murder cases was discovered shot to death in Bogota, authorities said on Friday.
Police said the body of Marceliano Cabezas Angulo, 45, was discovered on Tuesday on a street in the north end of the capital with two gunshot wounds to the head.
His identity was unknown until Friday morning when family members, who said he had been missing since early Tuesday, identified his body, a police spokesman said.

Among other high-profile cases he was involved in, Cabezas was the lead defence attorney for a leading suspect in the November 1995 assassination of Alvaro Gomez, a three-time presidential candidate and veteran political leader.

Gomez's brother, Sen. Enrique Gomez, declined to speculate on a possible motive for the killing of Cabezas, which police described as a mystery. But he told Reuters he did not rule out a possible link to the murder of his brother, an unsolved case for which as many as 14 people have been detained.

"This case has ties that go very high up," he said, alluding to previous allegations that senior government or military officials may have played a role in his brother's shooting outside a Bogota university in broad daylight. "People who find out about certain things run a very high risk," he added.
